pcb.geometry: Routed tscircuit PCB and its actual component placement. The GLB export checks for a mesh for every fitted placement. Copper test pads appear in the PCB texture.
pcb.routing: Board copper comes from the normal board source. External harnesses are CAD-only.

peltier.description: Same Sky CP60440, one sealed single-stage TEC
peltier.geometry: Nominal body drawn from the CP60 mechanical drawing. The marked cold ceramic faces the cold plate. The model depicts the factory lead exits and illustrative bends.

officialCadAttempts.result: Native model follows GCT's body and mating cavity dimensions. The shell and insulating tongue are shown in the installed orientation.
Manufacturer-linked CAD export requires registered authorization. Use TI RYQ0021A drawing-derived 5 x 3 x 1 mm maximum-height package envelope where no supplier mesh is present.
The manufacturer specifies the stainless sleeve dimensions, cable diameter and lead colors. Model drawn from those dimensions.

officialCadAttempts.part: Noctua NF-A8 family CAD for selected NF-A8 PWM
officialCadAttempts.result: Official STEP and manufacturer usage notice downloaded and retained. Offline tessellation preserves external/mounting geometry at moderate detail; internal geometry follows the manufacturer public-model limitation. See fan.geometry for conversion/source provenance.

assemblyLimitations: Bench fixture geometry, with simplified heatsink fins and cable paths. Machining fit, clamp force, airflow and thermal performance require checks on the built fixture.

thermalStack.fanDuct: Original CAD in src/assembly/thermal-stack.ts, exported as fan-duct.stl

usbCables.description: Two Cable Matters 201440 USB-C to USB-C USB 2.0 data / 240 W / 5 A cables, 1 m option

roles.role: PD power from 100 W USB-C charger

usbCables.electricalRating: Manufacturer specifies up to 48 V / 5 A power delivery, an E-Marker, and USB 2.0 data up to 480 Mbps. Both roles can use this same cable product. Board data speed is determined by its USB implementation.
usbCables.geometry: Connection illustrations. Only short segments and board-side plugs are shown. Manufacturer does not publish plug/jacket CAD or dimensions; shapes and role colors are indicative, not fit-qualified geometry. Cable slack, charger end and PC end are omitted.

nativeAssembly.geometry: Native assembly.device with the routed PCB and CAD-only parts for the thermal stack, probes, fan, and wiring. The fan uses official NF-A8 family CAD. Body dimensions follow the selected parts and the custom plate drawings. Cable paths and connector mating heights are illustrative.

temperatureProbes.description: Two DFRobot DFR0198 wired stainless DS18B20 probes
temperatureProbes.housingDimensionEvidence: DFRobot specifies a 6 × 35 mm stainless tube and 4 mm cable. Its Wiki gives 900 mm cable length and the product introduction gives 950 mm.
temperatureProbes.geometry: Drawing-derived 6 × 35 mm cylinder and 4 mm jacket. The three exposed conductors use DFRobot lead colors. The preview shows shortened paths.
temperatureProbes.placement: HOT sits in the heatsink base bore and COLD sits in the cold-plate bore. Explode the stack in the viewer to inspect the probe bodies.

fan.description: Noctua NF-A8 PWM 12 V, direct factory cable without Low-Noise Adaptor or extension
fan.cableDescription: Manufacturer 26 AWG, black mesh-sleeved four-wire factory cable with A2543-4PIN (or equivalent) plug; mates the Molex47053-1000 header.

geometry.source: Official Noctua NF-A8 family CAD, used for the selected NF-A8 PWM external and mounting dimensions; not a uniquely PWM-specific STEP.
geometry.appearance: Manufacturer CAD colors retained where supplied. Uncolored rotor meshes use brown [0.26, 0.12, 0.06]; uncolored label mesh uses gray [0.12, 0.12, 0.12]. These are visualization defaults.
geometry.manufacturerLimit: Manufacturer permits visualization/integration reference. Internal impeller geometry is modified to protect IP; not for performance simulation or reproducing/manufacturing the fan.

fan.cableGeometry: Illustrative keyed plug and sleeve. The contact and key XY coordinates match the board footprint. The route fits within the nominal 200 mm factory cable.
fan.placement: Fan flange meets the 71.5 mm mounting pattern on the printed inlet duct. The physical fan's discharge side faces the heatsink fins.
fan.electricalUse: Pins 1/2 provide fixed 12 V power. Pin 3 tach and pin 4 PWM remain physically present in the plug but are NC on the board; unconnected PWM runs at full speed. Manufacturer maximum input current is not a published startup-current peak.
